name: Ring of Animal Influence
body: This ring has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can expend 1 charge to cast one of the following spells (save DC 13) from it: - Animal Friendship - Fear (affects Beasts only) - Speak with Animals
